trechos: Palantir Co-Founder and FTC Chairman Put AI Accountability in Focus at Reuters Momentum AI Austin 2026 Day two examines human control, consumer protection and the business changes needed to turn increasingly autonomous systems into lasting value.

In conversation with Reuters Global Defense Editor Joe Brock, Lonsdale, who also founded venture capital firm 8VC, argued that humans must remain responsible for the authority granted to autonomous systems.
